ways.name: The Dark Path
ways.difficulty: statistically harder, should FEEL much harder

thresholds_open: No numeric VP or Light thresholds exist anywhere in the corpus. Ways 1 and 2 must be statistically EQUAL and Way 3 slightly harder — unverifiable until numbers exist (GDD Q6).

tiebreakers.rule: more VP from Guardian quests wins

collective_viability.rule: a player can only win if every active player still has a viable path to win
collective_viability.note: OPEN — 'viable path to win' has no operational test (GDD Q7)

endgame.master_guardian: resides at the centre (third ring) of the 4D Board
endgame.trigger_a: defeating the Master Guardian -> all players get exactly one more round
endgame.trigger_b: any standard §11 victory before the Absolute Challenge -> also triggers the final round (loop preventer)

house_rule_optional: a Dark-path winner may not choose Dark the next round
